# zever — llms.txt

Go multi-module monorepo (`go 1.27.0`): schema-driven scaffolding compiler
(`.zen` DSL) plus swappable backend batteries. Workspace: `go.work` at root.
Conventions: `AGENTS.md` (repo root).

## For coding agents: start here

- `AGENTS.md` — build/test/lint commands, error and test conventions.
- `docs/src/content/docs/digging-deeper/ai.mdx` — LLM facade (`core/ai`),
  agent loop (`core/agent`), RAG (`core/rag`).
- `container/README.md` — service resolution (`container.New(cfg)`, lazy
  accessors, close order).
- `config/README.md` — layered config (`defaults < file < env`).
- `cmd/zever/README.md` — CLI; `zever --help --agent` prints a
  machine-readable command descriptor, `--json` selects JSON output.
- `skills/zever/SKILL.md` — Claude Code skill; regenerate from any pinned
  binary with `zever docs --skill --dir skills/zever`.
- `docs/src/content/docs/tutorials/build-an-agent-app.mdx` — end-to-end
  agent app walkthrough.
- `dsl/README.md` — `.zen` compiler pipeline and codegen backends.

## Machine interfaces

- MCP server: build `tools/zever-mcp`, register the binary as an MCP stdio
  server. Tools: `zever_compile`, `zever_schema`, `zever_explain`,
  `zever_doctor`, `zever_generate` (elicitation-gated). Also serves static
  resources and prompt templates.
- OpenAPI: `zever compile --backend openapi` emits one document per module
  plus a merged `openapi.json`.
- MCP tool manifest: `zever compile --backend mcp` emits one manifest per
  service (each RPC becomes a tool with JSON Schema input/output).
- JSON Schema for one entity: `openapi.JSONSchemaForEntity` in
  `dsl/backend/openapi` (feed to `agent.GenerateStructured`).

## Layout

- `core/<battery>` — one interface + registry (`Register`/`Open`); the
  container is the sole resolver. `core/agent` (tool loop) and `core/rag`
  (retrieval) compose backends and have no registry.
- `adapters/<battery>/<name>` — one Go module per adapter, self-registering.
- `shared/*` — dependency-free helpers. `dsl/` — compiler frontend
  (compile-time only; runtime packages must not import it).
